verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Replit Agent connects to external tools through MCP. It ships a curated catalog of servers (Stripe, Linear, Notion, Sentry), lets you add a custom server by URL, and lets admins set up services centrally for a workspace. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP client works as documented, and detail on transports and authentication for custom servers.
